body: Got the PS5 yesterday. Sealed box, free shipping hit in 2 days to Atlanta. Price was straight, no weird fees.
Works fine. Outer carton had a ding but the console box inside was clean. Wouldve liked tracking updates a little sooner.
Bought one for my nephew. Came quick and it was the disc version like the listing said. No drama.
Console is good. Support took a day to confirm my order tho. Once it shipped everything was fine.
Honestly cheaper than GameStop around me. Factory seal looked legit. Hooked it up same night.
Ordered for my store giveaway. Arrived on time. Only knock is packing peanuts everywhere lol.
Second one I grabbed from here. Same deal as last time. Solid for flipping or gifts.
Took a minute for them to email me back but the unit showed up clean. Fair price for a sealed PS5.
Bought 2 of the 7.5ft firs for the shop floor. Full looking trees, hinges werent junk. Customers asked about them already.
Nice tip density. One carton corner was crushed but tree inside was fine. Ordering a few more next week.
Frosted look is soft not chalky. Put one in the front window and it photographs well.
Tree itself is fine. Flock sheds a little when you fluff it. Wear gloves like they said.
Warm white LEDs look cozy. Plugged in and half the string lit first try, no dead bulbs on my unit.
Good prelit for the money. Stand is plastic but holds. Sold three out of five on day one at the pop up.
This is the nicer prelit. Denser than the 6ft we had before. Worth the bump if youre doing showroom.
Classic green pine, nothing fancy, just works. Easy fluffing. Bought singles instead of a whole case which helped.
White tree looks sharp with gold ornaments. Color was even, not yellowy. Shipping was free on mine.
Full spruce profile like the pics. A couple tips bent in transit but shaped back out. Still a keep.
Electronics mix was pretty much what the manifest said. Couple scuffed boxes but sellable stuff.
Ok pallet. Not a home run but we cleared most of it. Wish there were more headphones.
Home goods pallet was clean. Lots of kitchen odds and ends my booth moves fast. Would buy again.
Footwear truckload sizes were mixed like they warned. Still solid pairs. Took some sorting time.
Mixed GM pallet was a grab bag in a good way. Found a few higher ticket pieces. Pics matched.
Tools are Grade C so expect scuffs. Most powered on. Price was right if youre patient testing them.
